name: glido
description: Private Codex prompt coaching, model routing, and weekly progress.

interface.shortDescription: Improve Codex prompts, model choice, and usage.
interface.longDescription: Glido privately audits local Codex sessions, uses the user's Codex login for opt-in prompt coaching, recommends the least expensive sufficient model, estimates credit and weekly-allowance savings, and creates a light localhost progress dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Coach my Codex prompts from the last seven days.
Show which tasks could have used a smaller model.
Estimate how much weekly allowance model routing could preserve.
